preview_explain: Shows the development PostgreSQL database. No vehicle or robot connection is active.
live_caption: Review the map, vehicles, ride requests, and server records.
login_caption: Use your admin Web account. If you are already signed in there, confirm the FMS connection.
browser_wait: Sign in to the admin Web app and confirm the PyQt FMS connection.
admin_browser_return: Return to AMO Admin. You can close this tab.
admin_tutorial_overview: Open either view to fetch the latest records. Refresh to request them again.
admin_tutorial_history: Enter a search or date range and use Previous or Next to browse one page at a time.
browser_return: Return to AMO FMS. You can close this tab.
browser_failed: Could not start browser sign-in. Please try again.
browser_timeout: Browser sign-in timed out. Please try again.
login_invalid: The sign-in connection expired. Connect again in your browser.
login_role: Check your operator role and account approval.
service_error: Check the backend connection and response.
session_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
snapshot_unavailable: Could not refresh server data. Last available snapshot is shown.
map_caption: Confirmed road layout · vehicle positions require map calibration.
map_missing: Check the map asset for this language.
select_hint: Select a vehicle from the fleet list.
queue_caption: Shows request intake and dispatch states confirmed by the server.
event_caption: Request acknowledgments and observed vehicle states are shown separately.
action_caption: Review an action for one vehicle in the development preview. No command is sent.
preview_result: {vehicle} · {action} · Preview only. The observed vehicle state has not changed.
offline_action: Action preview is available for connected or explicitly simulated vehicles.
tutorial_auto: Show the walkthrough at first sign-in
tutorial_monitor: Use the map and fleet list to review each vehicle’s status, battery, and connection separately.
tutorial_queue: Calls & dispatch shows pickup, destination, and the state confirmed by the backend.
tutorial_events: Use server events to distinguish request acceptance from observed vehicle states. A local preview never sends a command.
tutorial_settings: In Settings, change language and theme, replay this guide, or turn off the first-use walkthrough.
action_details: Check the selected vehicle’s connection first.
detail_demo_waiting: Demo request awaiting an eligible vehicle.
review_scope: Run the Taxi server and screen review. Intersection, emergency stop, Rent and Cargo cases currently use offline tests.
review_pending: No observations recorded for this step.
review_plan_taxi_apply_failed: Taxi · route failure after mock payment
review_error_scenario_run_superseded: A newer review is active. View saved steps or start a new review.
review_error_scenario_waiting_android: Complete this action for the current call in Android, then retry.
review_error_scenario_service_unavailabl: Review service unavailable. Check the demo server and administrator sign-in.
review_error_scenario_step_out_of_order: Progress has changed. Refresh to find the next step.
review_error_scenario_expectation_mismat: The server result did not meet this scenario’s expected conditions.
review_expect_initial_ready: Enter waiting while the bay remains occupied.
review_expect_initial_vacate: Bay departure enables a demo assignment.
review_expect_call: A new request is received before assignment.
review_expect_quote: Link the mock distance, time and fare to the call.
review_expect_prepay: Record the owner’s successful mock payment before dispatch.
review_expect_assign: Assign this run’s vehicle to the call.
review_expect_pickup_stop: Wait for boarding after the pickup stop.
review_expect_board: Confirm boarding on the same assignment.
review_expect_depart: Show the trip in progress after departure is reported.
review_expect_stop_wait: Prepare a route change while stopped.
review_expect_change_propose: Propose S4 while S2 remains effective.
review_expect_change_accept: Record the successful difference payment and keep S2.
review_expect_route_issue: Issue a command for the revision while S2 remains effective.
review_expect_route_applied: Switch to S4 after matched application evidence.
review_expect_route_failed: Keep the paid attempt and failure evidence, with S2 effective.
review_expect_redepart: Confirm redeparture separately from route application.
review_expect_destination_stop: Record the stop at the effective destination.
review_step_alight: Alight, finalize fare and issue receipt
review_expect_alight: Finalize the effective fare and issue one receipt.
review_expect_return_order: Save the return order for the same trip.
review_expect_return_arrival: Distinguish vehicle arrival and bay occupancy.
review_expect_return_occupy: Record occupancy of the run’s bay after arrival.
review_expect_return_charge: Record charging under the same facility cycle.
review_expect_return_ready: Enter waiting while the bay remains occupied.
review_expect_return_vacate: Record departure and close the facility cycle.
review_evidence_only: Only inspect saved records on click
review_reset_confirm: Delete {runs} review runs and {observations} observations? Archived records are retained.
review_error_scenario_reset_changed: The history changed after confirmation. Check the counts again.
review_expect_prepay_declined: Record the declined mock payment and hold assignment until payment succeeds.
review_expect_link_lost: Stop the simulated vehicle and require link recovery.
review_expect_link_restored: Restore the connection and hold the vehicle for operator approval.
review_expect_resume_approved: Allow a new simulated departure after the operator approves it.
forecast_scope: Four-vehicle simulation replay. Wait is the time until the next currently queued vehicle is granted entry.
forecast_unavailable: The replay could not be read or its map does not match.
